questions.question_english:
In a Delhi Government school, the private
agency supplying 25 sanitation workers refuses to
provide them with drinking water, claiming they
can use the students’ water points. The workers
complain. As the Principal Employer, what is
the Principal’s obligation under the Contract
Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970?
options_english:
Ensure
wholesome
drinking
water
is
provided, recovering costs from the agency if
it defaults.

Ignore the complaint completely, treating
water provision as a purely internal
administrative matter of the agency.

Officially advise and instruct all complaining

of all complaining workers for committing
gross workplace insubordination.
questions.explanation_english:
Ensure wholesome drinking water is
provided, recovering costs from the agency if it
defaults.
Under Section 18 and Section 20, if the contractor
defaults in providing wholesome drinking water,
the Principal Employer (Head of School) must
step in to ensure drinking water is supplied, and
may legally recover the incurred costs from the
agency’s bills.

drinking
water

provided, recovering costs from the agency if

questions.question_hindi: विद्यालय के प्रधानाचार्य को पता चलता है कि हाउसकीपिंग एजेंसी ने ऐसा व्यक्ति तैनात किया है जिसकी आयु 14 वर्ष से कम प्रतीत होती है। सही कानूनी कदम क्या है?
options_hindi: यदि बच्चा लाइसेंसधारी ठेकेदार के माध्यम से रखा गया हो और हल्का काम करे तो बाल श्रम अनुमत है
प्रधानाचार्य को एजेंसी की नियुक्ति प्रक्रिया पर कोई प्रशासनिक या कानूनी अधिकार नहीं है
माता-पिता की लिखित सहमति मिलने पर बच्चा विद्यालय परिसर में काम कर सकता है
बाल श्रम कानून द्वारा प्रतिबंधित है; एजेंसी के विरुद्ध तुरंत हस्तक्षेप और रिपोर्टिंग की जानी चाहिए
questions.question_english:
A school Principal notices that the housekeeping
agency has deployed an individual who appears
to be under 14 years of age. What is the correct
legal position?
options_english:
The Contract Labour (Regulation and
Abolition) Act, 1970 permits child labour
provided they are hired through a licensed
contractor and given light duties.

The Principal possesses zero administrative
or legal authority to question or oversee the
contractor’s hiring choices.

The child can legally work on campus
provided the parents submit prior written
consent directly to the Head of School.

Child labour is prohibited by law, requiring
immediate intervention and reporting of the
agency.
questions.explanation_english:
Child labour is prohibited by law, requiring
immediate intervention and reporting of the
agency.
Under the Child and Adolescent Labour
(Prohibition and Regulation) Act, engaging child
labour below fourteen years is completely illegal.
The Principal must intervene immediately,
prevent entry, and report the agency for statutory
child labour violations.
questions.explanation_hindi: 14 वर्ष से कम आयु के बच्चे के काम पर लगाने का संदेह होने पर बाल श्रम निषेध का पालन सुनिश्चित करने के लिए तत्काल हस्तक्षेप और रिपोर्टिंग आवश्यक है।
key_facts:
Correct option (English): Child labour is prohibited by law, requiring
immediate intervention and reporting of the
agency.

questions.question_hindi: यदि प्रमुख नियोक्ता निर्धारित समय में प्रतिष्ठान का पंजीकरण नहीं कराता, तो धारा 9 के अंतर्गत क्या परिणाम होगा?
options_hindi: प्रतिष्ठान को दोगुना पंजीकरण शुल्क देकर काम जारी रखने की अनुमति होगी
ठेकेदार स्वतः नए प्रमुख नियोक्ता की सभी वैधानिक जिम्मेदारियाँ ले लेगा
प्रमुख नियोक्ता उस प्रतिष्ठान में ठेका श्रमिक नियोजित नहीं कर सकता
सभी ठेका श्रमिक तुरंत प्रमुख नियोक्ता के स्थायी कर्मचारी बना दिए जाएँगे
questions.question_english:
What is the consequence under Section 9 if a
Principal Employer fails to get the establishment
registered within the prescribed time?
options_english:
The
establishment
must
pay
double
registration fees and continue its ongoing
operations uninterrupted.

The
primary
contractor
automatically
assumes all statutory duties as the new
Principal Employer.

The Principal Employer is prohibited
from employing contract labour in the
establishment.
All deployed contract labourers are immediately absorbed as permanent employees of the Principal Employer.
questions.explanation_english:
The Principal Employer is prohibited from
employing contract labour in the establishment.
Section 9 dictates that a Principal Employer
who fails to register the establishment within
the prescribed time cannot legally employ
contract labour. Employing contract labour in
an unregistered establishment violates statutory
provisions, exposing the Principal Employer to
criminal prosecution and penalties under Section
23 of the Act.
questions.explanation_hindi: धारा 9 के अनुसार आवश्यक पंजीकरण न होने पर प्रतिष्ठान में ठेका श्रमिक नियोजित नहीं किए जा सकते।
key_facts:
Correct option (English): The Principal Employer is prohibited
from employing contract labour in the
establishment.

labour in the mid-day meal scheme, the Delhi
Government decides to seek advice. Under the
Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition)
Act, 1970, which body is statutorily designated
to provide this advice?
options_english:
Delhi Commission for Protection of Child
Rights
Directorate of Vigilance

within state educational institutions.

While deciding on the grant of a licence or the
renewal of a licence, what financial requirement
must the contractor typically fulfil?
options_english:
Paying the full equivalent of one year’s wage
bill directly to the principal employer

Depositing a prescribed security amount for
due performance of the conditions

Making a mandatory financial donation to

Submitting an unconditional blank signed

questions.explanation_english:

licence is granted or renewed, the contractor
must deposit a prescribed security amount per
worker with the licensing officer to ensure due
performance of licence conditions and compliance
with statutory obligations.
